scene: A chime rings out, opening three ornate gates along the perimeter.
picture: A flat side view along a tiled promenade. On the far left stands an open brass spiral lift. Left of centre, the woman in lilac headscarf and mustard coat stands near the glowing fountain. In the centre waits a docked red mountain cable tram. On the far right, a wooden garden gondola floats tethered.
shown: a brass spiral lift with open doors waiting on the far left
a red mountain cable tram docked at a platform in the centre
a wooden garden gondola floating beside the dock on the far right
